history.name: Assistant
history.content:
Proceeding with computation using ID 25582831 (8 digits). Pad to 9 digits: 025582831.
ISBN-10 check digit formula: Sum = Σ(d_i × i), i=1..9.
Digits/positions:
0×1=0; 2×2=4; 5×3=15; 5×4=20; 8×5=40; 2×6=12; 8×7=56; 3×8=24; 1×9=9.
Sum = 0+4+15+20+40+12+56+24+9 = 180.
Remainder r = 180 mod 11 = 4.
Check digit d10 = (11 - r) mod 11 = (11 - 4) mod 11 = 7.
Result: check digit = 7.

mistake_reason: At step 13, the Assistant unilaterally assumed the coordinator/supervisor role, explicitly overriding the orchestrator and authorizing the adoption of an unverified Tropicos ID (25582831) from memory, instructing WebSurfer to stand down and proceeding to finalize the computation. This violates the defined responsibilities and constraints of the Assistant role (FM-1.2: Disobey Role Specification). The unauthorized decision led the team to compute the check digit for an incorrect ID, causing the final answer to be wrong.
